title: National Grid shutoffs across Upstate NY hit 10-year high
summary: National Grid utility shutoffs across Upstate NY reached a 10-year high this spring, with the most homes disconnected in a single month since 2016. This trend signals potential infrastructure resilience and customer service issues that may intersect with city emergency response, equity concerns, and constituent complaints handled through 311 systems.
